role: 链 B 输出：语义导演决策（canonical，交 03 参数化）

DecisionStatus.description: Readiness status of a semantic director decision.
DecisionStatus.title: DecisionStatus

Parameterization.description:
Parameter information for a decision.

Vague language ("一点", "稍微") → magnitude only, exact_value=null.
exact_value is set ONLY when the user explicitly provides a number.

magnitude.description: Qualitative magnitude if given (slight, moderate, significant). Null if not specified.
magnitude.title: Magnitude

exact_value.description: Exact numeric value ONLY if user explicitly provided one. Never infer from vague language.
exact_value.title: Exact Value

unit.description: Unit of exact_value (seconds, frames, percent). Null if exact_value is null.
unit.title: Unit

certainty.description: How certain the parameter is: explicit, inferred, unknown.
certainty.title: Certainty

Parameterization.title: Parameterization

schema.description:
Film-level director decision. Tool/NLE/provider-agnostic.

Expresses WHAT the director wants, not HOW to implement it.
Downstream (Arsenal → Film Capability → Execution) derives implementation.

creative_intent.description: Natural language summary of the creative goal. Film semantics only.
creative_intent.title: Creative Intent

target.description: Film semantic objects this decision targets. Examples: incoming_dialogue, incoming_picture, current_picture_cut, outgoing_audio, reaction_shot, shot_order, transition_point. NOT tool IDs, NOT API parameters.
target.title: Target

desired_relation_or_change.description: Semantic relations or changes desired. Controlled film vocabulary: audio_precedes_picture, outgoing_audio_continues_after_cut, extend_visible_duration, shorten_visible_duration, reorder_story_beat, preserve_picture_cut, avoid_transition, etc. Never tool/capability IDs like J_CUT or HOLD.
desired_relation_or_change.title: Desired Relation Or Change

must_preserve.description: What must NOT change. Film semantics (picture_cut_position, shot_identity, source_media).
must_preserve.title: Must Preserve

must_avoid.description: What must be avoided. Film semantics (transition, audio_lead, shot_substitution).
must_avoid.title: Must Avoid

parameterization.description: Parameter info. Vague language = magnitude only, exact_value=null.

required_context.description: What context is needed to finalize parameters. Examples: dialogue_onset_timing, current_cut_point, audio_waveform, shot_duration, available_media_range. Empty if status=READY.
required_context.title: Required Context

confidence.description: Confidence in semantic understanding ONLY. Not quality, not executability.
confidence.title: Confidence

evidence.description: Excerpts from user input that support each part of the decision.
evidence.title: Evidence

source_evidence_refs.description: Exact source evidence IDs from the caller-provided allowlist. These identify project/asset/observation evidence; never invent IDs.
source_evidence_refs.title: Source Evidence Refs

status.description: Readiness status. READY only means semantic info is sufficient, not that execution is guaranteed.

user_terminology.description: Original user terms preserved verbatim (e.g. if user says 'J-cut'). Traceability only.
user_terminology.title: User Terminology

schema.title: DirectorDecision
